mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, ORDER_CREATED_AT, PAID_AT, SHIPPING_STARTED_AT, EXPECTED_DELIVERED_AT, SHIPPED_AT, CONFIRMED_AT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('READY', 'REFUNDED') ORDER BY ORDER_CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE, ORDER_CREATED_AT, PAID_AT, SHIPPING_STARTED_AT, EXPECTED_DELIVERED_AT, SHIPPED_AT, CONFIRMED_AT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
SELECT ORDER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, EXPECTED_DELIVERED_AT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS = 'SHIPPING' AND EXPECTED_DELIVERED_AT <= #{now}
SELECT ORDER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, PAID_AT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS = 'SHIPPED' AND DATE_ADD(PAID_AT, INTERVAL 7 DAY) <= #{now}
